unnecessary-legacy.title: Please don't use the legacy version
unnecessary-legacy.message: You are using the 'Legacy' version of {APP_NAME} on a device that doesn't need to. This is insecure, slower, and may PERMANENTLY delete your settings and backpack. Please install the normal version instead.

desktop-settings.update-checker-not-allo: Updates are managed by the store you installed the app from.

desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-w: Use graphics acceleration when available (requires restart)
desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-d: Disabling graphics acceleration significantly reduces performance. Some projects can run over 100x slower as all rendering will be done by your CPU. This should only be done as a last resort if graphics acceleration is causing crashes.
desktop-settings.background-throttling-d: Tillåter att gömda fönster kommer vara aktiva som kommer använda mer av processorn och förkorta Batteri-livet.

desktop-settings.associations-unsupporte: File associations can only be managed on Windows.

desktop-settings.home-reset-desc: Restore the default home page logo, title text and background
desktop-settings.home-background-desc: A custom background image for the home page. Buttons switch to a liquid glass style

downgrade-warning.title: Downgrading is not supported
downgrade-warning.message:
You are using an older version of {APP_NAME} after using a later version. Please exit and download the latest version from {website}.

If you continue, it is VERY LIKELY that you will PERMANENTLY lose all of your settings and backpack. We WILL NOT be able to recover your data.

(Debug info: {debugInfo})
